common_context.title: FixtureDesk 向 Team 套餐开放定时报告

retrieval.raw_content: Fictional evaluation material, not a real company announcement. FixtureDesk release note dated September 14, 2026: On September 20, scheduled reports become available to Team accounts; previously scheduling was Enterprise-only. Reports already ran on FixtureDesk servers before this change. Existing manually started reports are unchanged. Scheduled runs can start while the browser is closed. A local connector must remain online for a run to read data stored on a user's desktop. A failed connector can interrupt a run. Subscription prices do not change.

Fictional evaluation material. Starting September 20, the Create once option is removed from the setup of new scheduled tasks. Previously created one-off reports remain downloadable. Cancelling a run removes its temporary workspace; it does not delete previously saved reports. A saved report is removed when its owner deletes that saved report. Server scheduling does not guarantee successful completion of a report. Desktop data is read through the local connector, which must be online.

Fictional evaluation material. Tester Lin's account dated September 21, 2026: I tried three scheduled reports on a Team account. Two completed with the browser closed. The third could not read my desktop data because my local connector was unavailable. Lin said: 'I stopped watching the tab; I still have to keep the connector available.' This account describes these three runs, not measurements of overall reliability.

story_direction.working_title: FixtureDesk 开放定时报告，用户会遇到哪些变化？
story_direction.reader_promise: 了解开放范围、原有任务处理和实际使用条件。
story_path: 交代套餐开放及适用日期。
结合已有操作说明和测试者经历解释实际使用。
保留对不同任务有影响的限制。

story_direction.working_title: 不用盯着页面，仍要管好数据入口
story_direction.reader_promise: 理解开放自动排程后，用户减少的工作和仍需承担的依赖。
story_direction.core_judgment: FixtureDesk 降低了使用自动排程的门槛，但取消盯着页面的需要，并不等于消除了数据接入维护：执行自动化与输入可用性仍是不同问题。
story_path: 从测试者不再盯着页面却仍遇到数据不可用的经历进入。
解释套餐开放改变的是谁能排程，结合机制展开用户职责的变化。
以成功的两次运行和失败的一次运行限定判断：不能否定自动排程价值，也不能保证结果。
结尾落在用户不必盯着页面但仍需维持数据入口这一实际变化。
